correctness.rationale: Ramras Proposition 4.9 proves this exact proper-subgroup coset complex is a wedge of 1560 S2, establishing rational homology concentration. Independently generated all 60 even permutations and 59 subgroups, computed 58 proper subgroup Möbius weights by descending containment, and for every g evaluated the fixed-coset character from centralizer*conjugacy-class intersection/|H|; traces by orders 1,2,3,5 are 1560,-84,-21,5, with class counts 1,15,20,24. Independent rational character arithmetic gives multiplicities V6=100,V4=95,V5=116; norm-square of V6 over rational character is two, properly dividing its complex inner product by two.
